reviews.title: Solid Product even if you have to sell the child to afford it!
reviews.comment: Ram Ram Ram! Works great, totally sattisfied with its speed and quality. The Rgb shines well and looks far better than previous generations of the same product. Price hurts thinking now but the price was reasonable compared to the rest of the ram available at the time. looks nice, good color. RGB controls work well with all the software ive tried so far too!

reviews.title: Bricked my pc
reviews.comment: Instant BSOD and power cycling after installing (Was already using ddr5 6000mt/s prior to). Switched back to old and didnt fix the issue. Had to reinstall windows. They work now at default 4800 but when I enable expo or xmp the bsod returns. Will change review if I figure out a solution before I try to refund
